reviews.text: 打了半小时终于见到boss，干掉boss后直接卡住了，人物动不了，没有胜利结算，给爷气笑了

Fun, simple roguelite, good pick if you like the genre. Bug to note: the complete the dungeons achievement doesn't unlock properly. I bought this game aiming for 100% completion, which takes about 20 hours total. But you wont get it until they fixed those 3 achievements.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44181848/] 【更多适合Steam Deck的好游戏推荐，请关注GPD掌机鉴赏家！】[/url] 玩起来太解压了，各种脑洞大开的武器，BD简直多到离谱，爽感一直在线。虽然画风有点搞笑，但Boss战一点不含糊，哥布林军阀和精灵女王个个嘴臭还手狠，被虐了还得夸一句机制做得挺细。 最爱村里那帮“不简单”的居民，尤其是吱吱大师，说话欠揍但给的buff真香。副本规则各不相同，不再是单纯的无脑割草，走位失误照样暴毙。 唯一的缺点就是太费鼠标，打嗨了容易按坏左键。总之，想找乐子又爱肉鸽构筑的，闭眼入，拉比值得！
2D pixel roguelite with 58 weapons and 277 relics! Fast combat, unique builds, and fun boss fights. Play as a goblin!
Laby's Village is a fun little roguelike. I love the quirky characters and crazy weapon combos. Just wish the achievement bugs would get sorted out.
The combat is fast and keeps you on your toes. Each dungeon feels fresh with its unique rules. I had a blast despite some annoying bugs here and there.
Laby's Village offers a unique blend of humor and challenge. The weapon and relic system is engaging, but some achievements remain unresponsive, which can be frustrating.
I enjoyed the fast-paced combat and quirky characters in Laby's Village. However, the game sometimes locks up after boss fights, disrupting the flow of play.
The weapon and relic build system is impressive and encourages experimentation. Each weapon feels distinct, adding depth to the gameplay. A solid choice for roguelike fans despite minor bugs.
